title: 27th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/27/1/2025).
Question from Vaikaradhoo MP Hussain Ziyad to the Minister of Defence, Mohamed Ghassan Maumoon: why are the agreements made between India and the Maldives not being made public?

Question from Vaikaradhoo MP Hussain Ziyad to the Minister of Defence, Mohamed Ghassan Maumoon: the government came to power saying Indian soldiers were in the Maldives, and the President and the minister now say they have been sent back; how many Indian soldiers have been sent back so far, and what weapons did they keep in the country?

Matter raised under Rule 201 of the Majlis Standing Orders by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim, to bring to the government's attention that a media outlet (named in the text as "Bandara" media) is repeatedly violating the law.
Preliminary debate on the Maldives Civil Aviation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhumalé Central MP Abdulla Shazmee.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the defence minister about undisclosed India agreements and the withdrawal of Indian soldiers, heard a matter about a media outlet breaking the law, and opened debate on the Civil Aviation Bill.
